Title: The top menu lists Apply Now, Track Applications, My Files and Account Settings
Pre-conditions: Signed in with the Applicant Portal module active
Test steps:
1. Open the Applicant Portal
2. Look at the top menu bar
Expected results: The four links are listed and lead to /portal/apply-now, /portal/track-applications, /portal/my-files and /portal/account-settings
Actual results: As expected. The portal has a top menu bar, not a sidebar
Notes: Playwright: applicant-applications.spec.ts. Needs ADMIN_STORAGE_STATE. The account is switched to the Applicant Portal module (user menu > Switch Module)

Title: My Files shows the document hub, the three info cards and the files table
Pre-conditions: Signed in with the Applicant Portal module active
Expected results: The heading 'My Submitted Documents' under an Applicant Document Hub badge. Three cards: Document Repository (number of files), Supported Formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, max 5MB per file) and Updates & Edits (Prior to Deadline). A table with a Search box, a Per page selector and the columns File Name, File Type, File Size, Application Details and Last Updated. Each row has Update File, View File and Download
Actual results: As expected (1 file attached to a different job, from an earlier test)
Notes: Playwright: applicant-applications.spec.ts. Needs ADMIN_STORAGE_STATE. The account is switched to the Applicant Portal module (user menu > Switch Module). The Update File, View File and Download buttons are only checked as shown, not clicked
